subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: What Telegram policy should OpenClaw use when a voice-message turn is dispatched late and then finishes without a visible final reply?
rationale: The code can add latency measurement or fallback text, but the threshold, restart/alert behavior, and whether DMs should receive a visible no-response/error message are product and transport-policy choices with message-delivery risk.

options.title: Define Latency And Fallback Policy
options.body: Keep the issue open and specify a source-message age threshold, diagnostics/restart behavior, and DM-visible fallback semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Drain Fix As Sufficient
options.body: Close only the ingress-delay portion as covered by the merged worker-spooled drain fix, leaving the abort/no-reply behavior to a separate canonical issue.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Do not choose the product behavior until a live or Crabbox Telegram run reproduces the delayed voice dispatch and abort/no-reply sequence on current main.

recommendation.title: Define Latency And Fallback Policy
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and specify a source-message age threshold, diagnostics/restart behavior, and DM-visible fallback semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent history match for Telegram liveness and the merged worker-spooled drain proof adjacent to this issue.
